title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Warsh Jackson Hole (1st speech as Fed Chair): "inflation still too high" — no forward guidance, "committed to a discipline, not a decision."
Sep rate-hike odds: ~33% → ~50%. 2-yr yield +6.6bp to 4.29% (1-month high).
Gold ~-2.5% to ~$4,580 (retreating from near $4,700 on hawkish repricing).
BTC $79,130, ~flat 24h — holding near 80k test level. S&P +0.5%, Nasdaq +0.6%.
DXY +0.4% to 99.55 (just under 0.7% alert threshold).
